blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–San Miguel Beer bounced back from its stinging loss to TNT by running roughshod over Terrafirma, 135-105, on Wednesday in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. George King dropped 44 points while June Mar Fajardo had his best game of the conference with 25 points and 12 rebounds as the Beermen improved to an 8-3 win-loss record. King was 11-of-20 from the field while Fajardo posted a conference-high while moving five points shy of joining the exclusive 10,000-point club.
